name: v_shop_directory_light
viewQuery: SELECT id, shop_id, name, business_type, phone, address, city, currency, slogan, subscription_tier, deployer_id, logo_file, (CASE WHEN logo_uri LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(logo_uri, '') END) AS logo_uri, updated_at FROM shop_profile

name: v_products_catalog_light
viewQuery: SELECT id, shop_id, shop_name, name, category, sell_price, buy_price, stock_quantity, min_stock_alert, barcode, unit, icon_name, is_available, image_file, (CASE WHEN image_uri LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(image_uri, '') END) AS image_uri FROM products

name: v_shop_ads_feed_light
viewQuery: SELECT id, shop_id, shop_name, business_type, city, phone, whatsapp_phone, logo_file, (CASE WHEN logo_uri LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(logo_uri, '') END) AS logo_uri, ad_title, ad_description, video_file, video_uri, video_duration_sec, cta_label, is_active, deployer_id, updated_at FROM shop_ads WHERE is_active = true

name: v_couture_models_public_light
viewQuery: SELECT id, shop_id, shop_name, title, category, description, price, estimated_days, image_file, (CASE WHEN image_uri LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN 'img_prod_mode' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(image_uri, ''), 'img_prod_mode') END) AS image_uri, is_featured, is_available, updated_at FROM couture_models WHERE is_available = true

name: v_restaurant_orders_live
viewQuery: SELECT id, shop_id, order_number, table_name, customer_name, source, status, items_json, total_amount, notes, assigned_to_kitchen_by, sale_id, created_at, updated_at FROM restaurant_orders

name: v_shop_daily_sales_stats
viewQuery: SELECT (CAST(shop_id AS TEXT) || '_' || date(timestamp / 1000, 'unixepoch')) AS id, shop_id, date(timestamp / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS sale_date_utc, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue_total, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discount_total, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost_price), 0) AS cost_total, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount - total_cost_price), 0) AS gross_margin_total, COALESCE(SUM(amount_paid), 0) AS paid_total FROM sales WHERE is_cancelled = false GROUP BY shop_id, date(timestamp / 1000, 'unixepoch')

name: v_app_users_public_safe
viewQuery: SELECT id, full_name, phone, city, neighborhood, photo_file, (CASE WHEN photo_uri LIKE 'data:image/%' THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(photo_uri, '') END) AS photo_uri, preferred_activity, is_seeking_accompaniment, accompaniment_details, is_shop_member, member_shop_name, member_shop_role, created_at, updated_at FROM app_users
